source.half_life_and_branching: NNDC NuDat 3 (Brookhaven National Laboratory), chart data file https://www.nndc.bnl.gov/nudat3/data/output.json (ground-state 'halflife' incl. 'inSeconds', and 'decayModes.observed')
source.Q_alpha: AME2020 atomic mass evaluation, file rct1.mas20 column Q(a): W.J. Huang et al., Chin. Phys. C 45, 030002 (2021); M. Wang et al., Chin. Phys. C 45, 030003 (2021); downloaded from https://www-nds.iaea.org/amdc/ame2020/rct1.mas20.txt. Identical (to 0.1 eV) to NuDat3's qValues.alpha for every row.
source.half_life_crosscheck: NUBASE2020: F.G. Kondev et al., Chin. Phys. C 45, 030001 (2021); https://www-nds.iaea.org/amdc/ame2020/nubase_4.mas20.txt
source.gs_to_gs_alpha_line: ENSDF alpha-decay datasets as served by NuDat3 decay radiation pages (url_decay_radiation per row)
source.IAEA_LiveChart_API: NOT used: https://nds.iaea.org/relnsd/v1/data (and www-nds.iaea.org/relnsd) returned a Cloudflare JS challenge (HTTP 403) on 2026-10-11, so no CSV could be retrieved.

notes: Selection: even-even (0+ ground state) alpha emitters, ground-state decay; all have alpha branch >= 99.88% except Cf-252 (96.9%, 3.1% spontaneous fission), included as requested and flagged.
Q_alpha_MeV is the total ground-state-to-ground-state decay energy (atomic-mass difference). E_alpha_kinetic_MeV = Q_alpha*(A-4)/A is computed here (non-relativistic recoil split using mass numbers).

E_alpha_gs_line_MeV_measured / alpha_gs_to_gs_intensity_percent: the highest-energy alpha line in the ENSDF decay dataset (the 0+ -> 0+ g.s. transition); intensity is per 100 decays of the parent. For actinides the g.s. line is ~67-81% with most of the rest going to the daughter's 2+ state; for Po/Rn it is >99.8%. Measured line energies agree with Q*(A-4)/A to within 1.5 keV (largest: U-236, -1.45 keV; Th-232, +1.07 keV).

half_life_s is NuDat3's own 'inSeconds' value; NuDat3 converts years with 1 y = 365.25 d = 31557600 s (Julian year; checked from the data). half_life_quoted is NuDat3's stored value + unit (unc = its +/- uncertainty in the same unit). half_life_s_nubase2020 is converted here from the NUBASE2020 string with the same 365.25-d year so the ratio column compares values, not conventions.
U-238: NuDat3 chart and NUBASE2020 give 4.463e9 y; the older ENSDF adopted-levels / decay-dataset evaluation (NDS 2007/2015) shown on the NuDat3 per-nuclide pages gives 4.468e9 y.

The NuDat3 per-nuclide pages in 'url' / 'url_decay_radiation' show ENSDF evaluations which can be older than the chart data (e.g. Po-212 294.3 ns on the adopted page vs 295 ns in the chart data; NUBASE2020 294.4 ns). The values in this file come from the chart data file (data/output.json) and AME2020 directly.
alpha_branch_percent '100' in NuDat3 means alpha dominant with only ultra-rare cluster/SF branches (listed in other_decay_modes_nudat3).
